_comment: EW4 / PH.5: label-keyword -> glyph inference for the coarse, label-agnostic entity types (CELL / ORGANELLE / EQUIPMENT / SAMPLE). Each entry is [[keyword, ...], primitive_name]; the first matching keyword wins, evaluation is top-to-bottom (order matters -- e.g. the EQUIPMENT 'blot' rule precedes 'gel' so 'Western blot' maps to western_blot, not gel). Keywords match at a word-start boundary. Only non-default glyphs are listed; a no-match falls through to the ENTITY_TO_PRIMITIVE type default. Keys are EntityType values; loaded by layout/_geom.py into _INFERENCE_RULES.
